notes: Adds a protected Source Documents backup-integrity gate. Before an encrypted vault export, TEE now checks the currently authorized protected Source Document overlays, verifies large-source linkage, and specifically flags itinerary records that have an encrypted original but no protected saved details. A passing check forces the active vault data to persist before export. A failing check blocks export rather than creating a backup that appears complete but cannot restore Saved Information.
name: TEE v3.4.39 — Source Documents Backup Integrity Review
